newsitem.title: GERMANY: Badenwerk, EVS Holding agree to merge.
newsitem.headline: Badenwerk, EVS Holding agree to merge.

text.p: The management boards of German utility groups Badenwerk AG and EVS Holding AG signed an agreement on Monday merging the two groups, Badenwerk said in a compulsory statement.
Badenwerk and Energie-Versorgung Schwaben (EVS) will merge with Energie Baden-Wuerttemberg AG to form Germany's fourth largest energy utility group, Badenwerk said.

The agreement will be approved at the two groups' respective annual meetings, which are both set to take place on August 20, Badenwerk said, but the shareholders of both groups agreed the merger in February.
